name: Pelican Pub
description: Pelican Pub is a lively and welcoming venue that offers a vibrant karaoke experience. Known for its friendly atmosphere, attentive staff, and good prices, it features a solid sound system and a song selection that satisfies most tastes. The venue often hosts karaoke nights with a fun, community-oriented vibe, making it a great spot to unwind, socialize, and enjoy singing your favorite tunes in a relaxed setting.
